critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage geometry to include two distinct horizontal window rows. For the main deck, create a long rectangular strip of windows with a height-to-length ratio of 1:20. For the upper deck 'hump' area, add a second, shorter row of windows positioned 5 units above the first, with a length equal to 40% of the main deck row. Within these rows, replace uniform dots with rectangular primitives spaced at 3-unit intervals, leaving 10-unit gaps to accommodate door frames.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck)

discrepancies.observed: No discernible door geometry or structural breaks in the fuselage skin
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door frames with visible seams

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck lacks a distinct row of windows separate from the main body
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, shorter row of windows on the upper deck 'hump'

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire fuselage length
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps around door locations and cockpit area
